---
title: "Activities"
subtitle: "How the network works together"
description: "Recurring formats of the Human- and Society-Centered AI Research Network."
---

::: {.page-lead}
The network keeps coordination light. Its formats are designed to connect people across faculties around real research questions, with as little administration as possible.
:::

::: {.principles}
- **Monthly open research forum.** Ongoing results, methodological problems and publication ideas – periodically with visiting researchers.
- **Research clinic every two months.** One pilot discussed in depth from psychological, social-science, engineering and data-science perspectives.
- **Annual doctoral day.** Doctoral candidates working on network topics present their work; the forum and the research clinic are open to them throughout the year.
- **Joint seminar and studies.** A common seminar, joint integrated studies or proposals, and topics for student research, theses and doctoral work.
- **Shared knowledge space.** An internal workspace for members and a curated research repository with appropriate licences.
- **Light record of results.** A record of projects, results and research impact that adds as little administration as possible.
:::

Dates for the recurring formats will appear on the [Events](/events.html) page.
